items.title: 13.11.1 Pani mein chlorine ka shamil hona (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11.1, printed page 301.

blocks.text: Jab chlorine gas pani mein dali jaye to woh hydrolysis se hydrochloric acid aur chloric(I) acid ke mixture mein badalti hai: Cl2(g) + H2O(l) se HCl(aq) + HClO(aq). Chloric(I) acid, HOCl, kamzor acid hai aur pani mein juzvi taur par hydrogen ions aur chlorate(I) ions, OCl-, mein dissociate hota hai.

blocks.caption: Chlorination par banne wali species
rows: hydrolysis; chlorine disproportionate hoti hai (-1 aur +1)
HClO H+ + OCl- ke saath equilibrium mein
kamzor acid, juzvi dissociation; tanasub pH par munhasir

blocks.prompt: Pani ki chlorination mein bunyadi faal species kya hain? Un ke banne ke muadle dein (Quick Check 13.6c).
blocks.explanation: HOCl aur OCl-. Cl2 + H2O se HCl + HOCl, aur kamzor acid phir juzvi ionise hota hai, HOCl H+ + OCl- ke saath equilibrium mein. (Hydrolysis khud chlorine ka -1 aur +1 mein disproportionation hai.)

items: Cl2 + H2O se HCl + HClO; HClO (kamzor acid) H+ + OCl- ke saath equilibrium mein: do faal species.
